rv.q: People who have seen other productions of Death of a Salesman may find this one weak by comparison. But it is still a powerful theatrical experience.
Gwydion’s production isn’t perfect, but it gets this point across, and it’s this that makes the show worth watching.
This Gwydion Theatre Company production, directed by Scott Westerman and stage-managed by Catalina Nino, is one of the best I’ve seen.

cn.t: Critics praise this production of Miller's classic, highlighting Rick Yaconis's brilliant portrayal of Willy Loman and the show's strong performances that bring raw emotion and contemporary resonance to the timeless American tragedy.
